gates.rule: a task at implemented or beyond has no proof entry that exited 0
an implementation unit's path is outside its component's root, or its file does not exist
a task that has started and is not verified, whose use case, screen or acceptance criterion an open CR freezes
a test file names a golden dataset and does not contain one of its expected values literally
a source or test file under a component root that no implementation unit owns
an edge written by dev points at a business rule
a gap with no CR and no answer
every skill a component names is installed in the session writing it
a scenario whose use case has a verified task and no test case covering it
a test case at verified with no run in which it passed
a finding routed to design or req with no change request
a run step or a finding names an evidence file that is not on disk
a finding at verified with no green run after it was raised
a test case that cannot be executed
a step on a data-testid is recorded and skipped
an end-to-end step must not re-prove what a unit test proves
